messages:
nate (NexaHealth): Hey @redwood-support -- the invoice INV-2024-8273 we just received is missing our PO (PO# NH-9021). Our AP won't process without it. Can you rebill or reissue with the PO?

elena (Support): Hi Nate — sorry about that. Can you confirm the invoice ID and the billing contact? Also do you want a credit + rebill or just an amended PDF with the PO visible? Some AP systems require a credit note + new invoice.

nate (NexaHealth): Invoice is INV-2024-8273. Billing contact is ap@nexahealth.com. We need the PO printed on the invoice header (exact string: NH-9021). AP rejected the invoice so we need it reissued.

elena (Support): Got it — looping in L2. @amira can you take this and check whether the invoice is paid/open? I'll stand by.

amira (Support L2): Doing lookup: `billing_cli get-invoice INV-2024-8273` -> status: open, amount: $18,450.00, po_number: null. Options: (A) create credit CN and new invoice with PO (recommended), (B) attach PO to PDF only (sometimes rejected). Finance approval required for credit.

sam_finance (Finance): @amira I can approve. @nate, quick confirm please: legal entity name and VAT/tax details? And confirm the exact PO string to appear on invoice.

nate (NexaHealth): Legal entity: NexaHealth LLC. No VAT. PO exactly: NH-9021. Billing email: ap@nexahealth.com.

sam_finance (Finance): Thanks — approving credit. I'll create credit note CN-2024-045 and issue new invoice INV-2024-8273-R1 with PO NH-9021. Expect the reissue within 4 business hours. I'll post the PDF when ready. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: credit CN-2024-045 created for INV-2024-8273 by sam_finance. New invoice INV-2024-8273-R1 queued.

amira (Support L2): @nate once the new invoice is issued please confirm the PDF shows PO in the header and in the metadata so your AP can match it. If you need PO in line-item notes we can add that too.

nate (NexaHealth): Got INV-2024-8273-R1 PDF — PO shows in header, looks good. I'll forward to AP. Thanks.

nate (NexaHealth): Quick follow-up from AP: their system flags invoices where PO appears only in metadata rather than printed in a line item reference. Is the PO printed anywhere other than header?

elena (Support): The PDF includes PO in the header and the invoice object has `po_number` set. We can also add a "PO ref" column on the line items if required. @sam_finance can modify format for this client if needed.

sam_finance (Finance): I'll update the invoice layout to include PO in a line-item reference. Will cancel R1 and reissue as INV-2024-8273-R1A with the adjusted layout. ETA ~2 hours.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2024-8273-R1A issued. CN-2024-045 applied. Status: open. PDF: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2024-8273-R1A.pdf

nate (NexaHealth): Confirmed AP accepted the R1A and scheduled payment. All good on our end — thanks everyone! :tada:

amira (Support L2): Closing loop here — marking resolved. If payment posts as failed or any VAT/tax flags appear let us know and we'll reopen the ticket.
